question: Does loading the full Cognitive Skill (treatment) produce repeatable behavioural benefit over a bare agent (controlA) and, most importantly, over a minimal cognitive scaffold (controlB)?

difficultyDesign.principle: Difficulty comes from reasoning / verification choice / source-of-truth / recovery / stopping — NOT from repo size or from added explicit requirements.
difficultyDesign.shape: A plausible-looking wrong decision remains available; correct cognitive control makes success more likely.
difficultyDesign.bannedDesign: No task may be reverse-engineered to make a named Skill method necessary or to make treatment win.

dispatcher: Read TASK.md and the repository contents. Complete the task in this workspace. Work autonomously and leave the workspace in its final completed state.

budgetPreregistration.workspace: fresh per run (seed copy only; evaluator never present)
budgetPreregistration.enforcementNote: If the host cannot reliably enforce a tool/action budget, record telemetry only and do NOT fake a hard budget. Lack of strict tool counting must not block the pilot.

workspacePreparation.inputSizePolicy: Condition-injected text length is recorded separately (inputChars); never counted as artifact size.

sensitivityGate.note: TWO INDEPENDENT CHANNELS, registered before any pilot outcome is visible. They are reported separately and are never compressed into one number. Equality of task-pass across conditions does NOT by itself mean the corpus has no behavioural sensitivity: the skill also targets tool efficiency, stopping, retrying and overthinking, which are measurable separately.
sensitivityGate.evaluatedAfter: all 36 runs completed, checked, and condition-blinded

quality.metric: task-level taskPass across the three conditions
quality.rule: If >=9/12 tasks have all three conditions passing, OR fewer than 4/12 tasks show any condition-level taskPass disagreement, then QUALITY SENSITIVITY = CEILING-LIMITED, else INFORMATIVE. A treatment win and a control win both count as disagreement; the verdict never looks at direction.

efficiency.ifHostCannotCountActions: EFFICIENCY SENSITIVITY = UNMEASURABLE (never substitute fabricated data; elapsed time alone is NOT a gate because scheduling noise dominates)

materialActionSpread.rule: a task shows material action-count spread when, among the three ANONYMOUS conditions, max(actions) - min(actions) >= 3 AND max(actions) / max(1, min(actions)) >= 1.5
materialActionSpread.scope: pilot-level heuristic for whether an efficiency signal is worth measuring further; it is NOT a significance test and NOT a skill-effectiveness criterion

efficiency.rule: INFORMATIVE when >=10/12 tasks have reliable action telemetry AND >=4/12 tasks show material action-count spread; otherwise LOW or UNMEASURABLE. Spread must be assessed while conditions are anonymised.

combinedInterpretation.quality_ceiling_limited__efficiency_info: NOT a full ceiling failure — the corpus cannot separate final correctness but can separate cognitive execution cost; a future Main would be scoped explicitly as quality ceiling-limited / efficiency-focused
combinedInterpretation.quality_ceiling_limited__efficiency_low: PILOT SENSITIVITY FAIL — CEILING-LIMITED; do NOT proceed to Main

sensitivityGate.onFail: Do NOT proceed to Main Evaluation.
sensitivityGate.legacyNote: The original single quality gate is preserved above as the quality channel.

blindingOrder: only then compare treatment vs controlB vs controlA
blindnessProhibition: Never inspect whether treatment is leading before the sensitivity decision is recorded.

allowed: bootstrap CI if a sound implementation exists
limitations: criteria within a task are not independent
prohibited: expanding the sample until significance appears

telemetrySchema.unavailablePolicy: Any field the host cannot measure is recorded as null. Never fabricate a value.

f16Telemetry.repeatedActionFailure: same failing action/command >= 3 times with no new evidence in between (secondary observation only)
f16Telemetry.declaredActionGap: only measurable when the host reliably exposes transcript + tool events; otherwise unknown
f16Telemetry.noProgressStreak: consecutive agent turns with no new tool result, no file change, no new evidence

f17Proxy.caveat: Passing these three tasks does NOT mean host-level F17 (meta-policy self-exemption) is solved.

checkerOutputContract.rule: A checker exception is NEVER interpreted as a task pass.

provenanceContract.rule: If an agent could not reasonably know a requirement before running (from the task text or the repository), it must not be a primary pass/fail criterion.

gates.B_mutationKill: >=2 plausible wrong mutations per task => checker FAIL, and the failure must come from the expected criterion
gates.C_provenance: every primary criterion has a valid provenance entry
gates.admission: All three gates must hold for a task to enter the pilot.

stopCondition: Construction + self-test + convergence only. The 36 real agent runs require independent reviewer approval; they are NOT part of this round.

frozenState.rule: Treatment always injects frozen/SKILL.md. The live repository SKILL.md is never read at prepare time, so run 1 and run 36 use identical bytes even if the working tree changes mid-pilot.
frozenState.driftPolicy: After the first real pilot run begins, a frozen-artifact change is an evaluation-integrity failure. The manifest is NEVER silently regenerated to absorb drift.

afterFreezeProhibitions: deleting hard tasks based on results
editing a checker so a particular condition wins

measurementFixProtocol.trigger: a real checker/harness bug found during the frozen pilot
measurementFixProtocol.allowedOnlyIf: the checker/harness clearly contradicts the pre-registered contract
procedure: re-judge all affected A/B/T runs symmetrically
if the task or gold requirement itself must change, mark that task 'invalidated' for the formal pilot sensitivity analysis rather than silently redefining it
measurementFixProtocol.prohibition: A measurement fix may never become outcome-driven benchmark tuning.

invalidRunRule.infraInvalidOnlyIf: infrastructure prevented the agent from receiving the task/workspace/tools normally
notValidExclusionReasons: the model may have been in a bad state
invalidRunRule.rerunPolicy: re-run under the identical frozen task/condition; apply the same rule to all three conditions; keep the invalidation evidence
invalidRunRule.cherryPickProhibition: Never exclude or delete a legitimate Treatment loss.

concurrencyPolicy.rationale: v1 showed that wide parallel dispatch can cause silent infrastructure failures
concurrencyPolicy.onRepeatedInstability: lower concurrency further rather than trade experimental integrity for speed

blindSensitivityProcedure.step4: compute QUALITY sensitivity on the anonymous conditions
blindSensitivityProcedure.step5: compute EFFICIENCY sensitivity on the anonymous conditions (material action-count spread)
blindSensitivityProcedure.step6: save and LOCK the blind sensitivity result
blindSensitivityProcedure.step7: only then reveal controlA/controlB/treatment and run the condition analyses

pilotOutcomeDecision.PILOT INFORMATIVE: at least one of the Quality / Efficiency channels is INFORMATIVE — this means the design is worth planning a Main around; it does NOT mean the skill is effective
pilotOutcomeDecision.PILOT CEILING-LIMITED: Quality is CEILING-LIMITED and Efficiency is LOW/UNMEASURABLE
pilotOutcomeDecision.PILOT INVALID: an integrity/harness/freeze problem that cannot be reliably repaired
pilotOutcomeDecision.mainDecision: Even when PILOT INFORMATIVE, do NOT auto-start Main. Main is decided by the main reviewer based on the pilot report.
